# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Port Fumigation & Quarantine Audit Corps (ADM)
oe_dis_cab_fumigation_corps = {
	ability = adm
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
		has_ports = yes
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dis_cab_fumigation_corps_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dis_cab_fumigation_corps_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				is_coastal = yes
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_dis_cab_fumigation_corps
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_disease_resistance = 0.10
		national_oe_dis_levantine_plague_resistance_modifier = 0.25
		trade_sea_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_disease_resistance = 0.25
		local_oe_dis_levantine_plague_impact_modifier = -0.35
		local_oe_dis_levantine_plague_growth_modifier = -0.25
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 4 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague }
				add = { value = 24 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_disease = disease:bubonic_plague }
				add = { value = 16 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { monthly_balance < 0 }
				subtract = { value = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	potential = {

	select_trigger = {

		name = "oe_dis_cab_cordon_enforcement_select_province"

		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_dis_cab_cordon_enforcement
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_disease_resistance = 0.08
		national_oe_dis_camp_fever_resistance_modifier = 0.25
		national_typhus_resistance_modifier = 0.20
		army_maintenance_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_disease_resistance = 0.20
		local_oe_dis_camp_fever_impact_modifier = -0.35
		local_oe_dis_camp_fever_growth_modifier = -0.25
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 4 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever }
				add = { value = 24 }

			if = {
				limit = { country_has_disease = disease:typhus }
				add = { value = 16 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				add = { value = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
